name: package-release
description: Weigh what the tree adds up to, cut a version, and get the tag to the remote on the development lane. Commands - unreleased, weigh, weigh-dry-run, release-cut, prerelease, push, verify-runbooks. Invoke when a version is being decided, cut or pushed, or when the claims in a runbook about the remote are being checked again.
author: UAK35
